dct_title_s: North Coast of Shantung : Chefoo to Weihaiwei including Chefoo or Yentai Harbor
dct_alternative_sm: Chefoo to Weihaiwei : including Chefoo or Yentai (Chih-Fou Wan) Harbor
dct_description_sm: From British surveys between 1860 and 1902, with additions from a survey by the Chinese Maritime Customs in 1918.
Depths shown by soundings and isolines; relief by land forms and spot heights.
Shows coasts, low water areas, drainage, vegetation, roads, buildings.
Authorities include British charts 1260, 3457, and Chinese charts 14, 15.
[Inset chart] : Chefoo (Yentai) Inner Harbor (Chih-Fou Wan) / From a survey by the Chinese Maritime Customs in 1918
